about_the_game:
If you can't get enough of the Handshakes theme song and / or you'd like to support us developers, grab the Handshakes Supporter Soundtrack Pack!

It includes:

  • The Handshakes Theme Song by (TrumpetGuy)
  • 2 Bonus Tracks (including a sneak peek track from Handshakes: Hands On)
  • All tracks in MP3 & FLAC
  • MIDI files for you to remix the songs
  • Digital Bio & Postmortem PDF [15 Pages] (an insight into us developers and the development of Handshakes) (Unfortunately, only available in English)

(to access the extras, click on the Browse Local Files button underneath the Play Album button on the Handshakes Soundtrack page in your library)
